name: Abandoned Barracks
arrivalText: Vines cover the crumbling stone towers of the old military barracks, now silent save for the harsh whispers of goblin squatters.
description: An abandoned border guard outpost built during the Second Orc War. Goblins have claimed the ruins, turning the old bunkrooms into dangerous traps and nests.
visualTheme: Decayed wooden floors, rusted iron gates, collapsed masonry, and crude goblin totems and barricades.

history.createdWhy: Built to house soldiers stationed along the eastern Oakhaven borders.
history.builtWho: Royal builders of the Eldorian Vanguard.
history.majorEvents: Abandoned after the war borders shifted east, leaving it empty for wood goblins to occupy.
history.whyExists: Remains as a dangerous hazard on the edge of Oakhaven's borders.
history.currentConflicts: Wood goblins from the barracks are launching small raids on Oakhaven's East Gate.
